{{ambox|text=
The in-game plural of "{{#rsplit:{{#df_tagvalue:{{ {{#ifeq:{{NAMESPACE}}|||:{{NAMESPACE}}}}:{{BASEPAGENAME}}/raw }}|NAME}}|:|0}}" is "'''{{#rsplit:{{#df_tagvalue:{{ {{#ifeq:{{NAMESPACE}}|||:{{NAMESPACE}}}}:{{BASEPAGENAME}}/raw }}|NAME}}|:|1}}'''". For consistency, please do not use {{#if:{{{not|}}}|"{{{not}}}" or other plurals|{{{notlist|other plurals}}}}} (see [[DF:Rule G|Rule&nbsp;G]]). {{#if:{{{bug|}}}|{{bug|link=1|{{{bug}}}}} has already addressed this issue.}}
